notes.12: Everyone else's first Reduce uses a. It still matches rank 1's first call, because collectives match by order.
notes.15: Only rank 0 has meaningful values in b and d.

summaries.all: Run with 3 processes. Rank 1 calls Reduce on c then a. Ranks 0 and 2 call it on a then c.
summaries.0: Rank 0 reduces a (1) first, then c (2). It is the root, so b and d are filled in.
summaries.1: Rank 1 reduces c (2) first, then a (1). Its first call is matched with the others' first call.
summaries.2: Rank 2 reduces a (1) first, then c (2), same as rank 0.
